name: retained_months_exam_year_mean
derivation: every acquisition pinned into the examination-year segment; active households summed over months divided by acquisitions summed over months

name: retained_months_pre_exam_mean
derivation: every acquisition pinned into the pre-examination-year segment, same arithmetic

name: retained_months_alevel_mean
derivation: every acquisition pinned into the A-level segment, same arithmetic

name: year10_to_year11_retained_months_ratio
derivation: pre-examination-year retained months divided by examination-year retained months, as the code produces it

name: year10_to_year11_ratio_p10
derivation: the same ratio at the tenth percentile of each

name: year10_to_year11_ratio_p90
derivation: the same ratio at the ninetieth percentile of each

name: share_paths_year10_at_least_doubles
derivation: share of paths on which the pre-examination cohort retains at least twice as many months as the examination cohort

name: year10_ratio_with_no_summer_at_all
derivation: the pre-to-examination retained-month ratio with the summer lapse pinned to zero and progression pinned to one: the summer removed entirely

name: year10_ratio_with_churn_at_its_floor
derivation: the same ratio with in-term churn pinned to the bottom of its prior range and the summer left as sampled

name: year10_ratio_with_no_summer_and_floor_churn
derivation: the same ratio with both pinned: this is the only combination that recovers the figure docs/10 reasons toward

name: retained_months_exam_at_floor_churn
derivation: examination-year retained months with in-term churn at the bottom of its prior range

name: retained_months_pre_at_floor_churn
derivation: pre-examination retained months with in-term churn at the bottom of its prior range

name: shock_longest_bad_run_mean
derivation: mean of longest_demand_shock_bad_run, a published column of por_paths.csv: the longest run of consecutive months with the demand multiplier below SHOCK_BAD_THRESHOLD

name: shock_longest_bad_run_p90
derivation: the ninetieth percentile of longest_demand_shock_bad_run in por_paths.csv

name: shock_share_paths_bad_run_6plus
derivation: share of por_paths.csv rows whose longest_demand_shock_bad_run is six or more

name: shock_share_paths_bad_run_12plus
derivation: share of por_paths.csv rows whose longest_demand_shock_bad_run is twelve or more

name: shock_rho_median
derivation: median of the shock_rho driver column

name: share_paths_content_exceeds_acquisition
derivation: share of paths on which total content cost exceeds total acquisition and verification spend

name: share_paths_content_is_largest_line
derivation: share of paths on which content is larger than both acquisition and people

name: share_paths_peak_funding_over_10m
derivation: share of paths whose peak funding requirement exceeds ten million dollars

name: share_paths_terminal_cash_positive
derivation: share of paths ending the horizon with cumulative cash above zero

name: final_year_hh_months_total
derivation: active households summed over paths and over the final twelve months

name: share_paths_with_a_real_final_year
derivation: share of paths with at least twelve final-year household months, which is the set the per-path medians below are taken over

name: final_year_contrib_per_hh_month_gross_pooled
derivation: total net revenue less inference, support, payment, hosting and app store fees over the final year, divided by total final-year household months: a gross margin, not a net one

name: final_year_contrib_per_hh_month_gross_median
derivation: median over paths with a real final year of the per-path gross contribution ratio

name: final_year_contrib_per_hh_month_allin_pooled
derivation: total net cash with acquisition and verification added back over the final year, divided by total final-year household months: net of engineering, content, overhead and compliance

name: final_year_contrib_per_hh_month_allin_median
derivation: median over paths with a real final year of the per-path all-in contribution ratio

name: allin_minus_gross_contrib_per_hh_month_pooled
derivation: the pooled all-in figure less the pooled gross one: what the gross margin leaves out

name: gross_minus_allin_contrib_per_hh_month_pooled
derivation: the pooled gross figure less the pooled all-in one: how much lower the all-in figure is

name: allin_consumed_per_hh_month_median
derivation: the median path's all-in contribution with the sign reversed: what a household month consumes on the median path

name: blended_retained_months_mean
derivation: retained months weighted by the sampled segment mix

name: final_year_ltv_gross_pooled
derivation: pooled gross contribution per household month times blended retained months

name: final_year_effective_cac_pooled
derivation: total final-year acquisition and verification spend over total final-year acquisitions, pooled across paths

name: final_year_effective_cac_median
derivation: median over paths with a real final year of the per-path effective acquisition cost

name: final_year_ltv_over_cac_pooled
derivation: pooled gross lifetime value divided by pooled final-year effective cost per acquisition

name: final_year_cac_pooled_over_anchor_median
derivation: pooled final-year effective acquisition cost divided by the median low-volume anchor: what the anchor understates by at the spend actually modelled

name: share_paths_final_year_ltv_below_cac
derivation: share of paths with a real final year on which gross lifetime value is below the final-year effective cost per acquisition

name: shock_cost_terminal_cash_mean
derivation: terminal cash mean with the demand shock as sampled, less the same with shock_sd pinned to zero: what the whole persistent-shock apparatus is worth

name: shock_cost_terminal_cash_median
derivation: the same on the median path

name: shock_cost_peak_funding_p80
derivation: the same on the eightieth-percentile peak funding requirement

name: shock_cost_on_worst_affected_mean
derivation: the same terminal-cash difference, over only the paths with a run of twelve or more bad months

name: shock_cost_on_worst_affected_median
derivation: the median of that difference over the same worst-affected paths

name: missing_night_rota_cost_per_year
derivation: three full-time posts at the median Bengaluru salary and overhead multiplier, with a thirty per cent night premium

name: missing_night_rota_cost_total
derivation: that annual cost from the UK go-to-market month to the end of the horizon

name: missing_night_rota_share_of_total_cost
derivation: the missing rota divided by the total modelled cost

name: por_total_cost_recomputed
derivation: sum over paths and months of every modelled cost line, averaged over paths
